brief:
One man was killed and others wounded in separate airstrikes across Gaza on Tuesday, Shehab Wire reported. In Nuseirat camp in central Gaza, a reconnaissance aircraft fired two missiles at a motorcycle, killing the man identified as Sobhi Sami Shehata. The strike marked one of multiple incidents across the territory.

Additional strikes struck Nuseirat camp and Gaza City, resulting in further casualties. The exact number of wounded and circumstances of the other strikes were not immediately detailed in initial reports from the scene.
